pages.title: Finding Kalendrite
pages.text: Default deposits: Nether, Y 27 to 120. Veins target up to 5 blocks, with 5 placement attempts per chunk. Mining requirement: level 4.

pages.title: Working Kalendrite
pages.text: Smelt Kalendrite Ore or Kalendrite Dust into ingots. Crushing the ore first normally yields two dusts. Ingots can be stored as metal blocks or converted into the material's other crafting forms.

pages.title: Default Tool Stats
pages.text: Durability: 212 uses.$(br)Harvest level: 4.$(br)Mining efficiency: 8.1.$(br)Material damage bonus: 4.0.$(br)Enchantability: 19.$(br2)These are the supplied material values. The item type, enchantments, and active traits affect final performance.

pages.title: Default Armor Stats
pages.text: Protection: helmet 1, chestplate 2, leggings 2, boots 1.$(br2)Toughness per piece: 3.0.$(br)Enchantability: 16.$(br)Extra full-set health: 8.0 HP.

pages.title: Armor: Tranquil
pages.text: If the player has not received any damage for the past 10 seconds and they don't have full hp, they gain a regeneration buff.

pages.title: Tool: Restoration
pages.text: Breaking blocks restores half a heart but tools lose more durability the lower the user's health is.
